paragraphs: A baraita reciter of R' Ami. Mentioned in Berakhot 14a, where he asked R' Ami a question.[^1]

notes.text: Both Ami titles are abbreviated and retained as R'. Tanna here is read as a baraita reciter associated with Ami, not a Tannaitic-era assertion or a further proved circle affiliation. שבעי מר׳ אמי is read as where he asked Ami; the older Shevai/conjecture speculation remains historical uncertainty, not evidence of a different reading. 14a follows the period convention without a named-edition check.
